name: f1-dev-tools
description: Reproduce, inspect, compare and validate Apex 26 camera and replay changes using the game's existing developer interface.

interface.longDescription: Five development workflows for brycejmurrin/f1-game: scene reproduction, camera inspection, before/after comparisons, WATCH replay transition checks, and camera preset preview/export. Uses the repository's apex-tools, playwright-official, chrome-devtools, js-debugger and apex-lsp MCP servers for deterministic game probes, live browser checks, performance inspection, source debugging and code navigation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the configured apex-tools MCP for game identity and diagnostics, then one browser MCP at a time: playwright-official for navigation/DOM/screenshots or chrome-devtools for live console/network/performance inspection. For source debugging, use js-debugger on the parent's existing local Chrome page; inspect fresh pause tokens and detach afterward. Reproduce and inspect the f1-game camera or replay problem, then validate the change with matching render traces.
